				subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier_delta = COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier_before }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_before = -0.1 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_after = -0.1 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_credit_0 = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_future_credit_0 = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_dual_veto }
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_credit_0 = 0.05 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_dual_veto }
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_future_credit_0 = 0.05 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_emirate_commands }
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_credit_0 = 0.07 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_emirate_commands }
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_future_credit_0 = 0.07 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_union_command }
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_credit_0 = 0.1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_union_command }
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_future_credit_0 = 0.1 }
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_before = COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_credit_0 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_after = COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_future_credit_0 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_before max = 0 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_after max = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_delta = COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_after }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_delta = COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_before }
				custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_UAE_fragmented_authority }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_preview_display = COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier_delta tooltip = bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier_tt }
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UAE_fragmented_authority }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier_after value = 0 compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_preview_fragmented_authority_army_org_factor_after value = 0 compare = equals }
					}
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UAE_fragmented_authority }
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				COLDWAR_UAE_apply_petition_independence = yes
			}
		}
	}
